cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(spake2 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
add_library(spake2 SHARED spake2-c/sha512.c spake2-c/spake2.c spake2_jni.cpp)
target_include_directories(spake2 PRIVATE spake2-c/include)
target_compile_options(spake2 PRIVATE -O2 -fvisibility=hidden -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections -include stdint.h)
target_link_options(spake2 PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384)
if(NOT ANDROID)
    find_package(JNI REQUIRED)
    target_include_directories(spake2 PRIVATE ${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()
